title: Add draft recovery notification banner in DocumentEditor
action: Show a dismissible 'Draft restored' banner when the editor loads with recovered content from useDraftCache.
implementation: In DocumentEditor.tsx, after useDraftCache loads persistedText and it is non-empty on mount, show a small banner above the editor: 'Draft restored — {relative time since last save}'. Use a showRecovered state that auto-hides after 5 seconds or on dismiss click. Add i18n keys: editorDraftRestored, editorDraftRestoredAt. Do not show if the text matches current conversation content (already saved). Style with existing Tailwind utility classes, matching the existing status bar aesthetic.
